dependency_semantics.start_after: Bundles that must close before this bundle's main work begins. Empty permits preparation only when concrete current inputs and permissions exist.
dependency_semantics.close_after: Additional bundles that must close before this bundle can claim completion. Work may start earlier against stable contracts, fixtures or identified canaries.
dependency_semantics.readiness: Never infer execution readiness from this graph alone; source, WorkUnit admission, host/input and existing authorization are also required.
dependency_semantics.feedback: Candidate repairs re-enter affected implementation and candidate/experience steps with new identity. The DAG describes forward baseline ordering, not a prohibition on repair loops.
dependency_semantics.mapping: Mappings preserve responsibility and prior-plan coverage, not status or permission. Broad umbrellas must be split into reviewable actual WorkUnits if needed.

later_work_not_0_1: Real provider consumers before stability freeze

acceptance: Compare actual integration with #246–#248 contributions and preserved Alpha.5 evidence; disposition stale active/pending records without claiming whole-journey completion.

acceptance: Record the next scenario's exact host, input custody, allowed roots/effects, reset and artifact export; other unavailable hosts block only their cells.
Identify feasible dev integration, provider-main promotion and laboratory paths; honor existing session authorization and prepare concrete missing decisions only when needed.

Keep licensed/effectful tests, untrusted source jobs and signing contexts separate. Record actionable blockers and resume triggers; never turn a missing release permission into an engineering-wide stop.

tasks.prerequisites: Current provider source/PR ancestry, checks and assurance; authorized provider integration. Provider WorkUnit names below are source-reported leads.
acceptance: Refresh #27/#28 rather than assuming their reported heads or statuses. Preserve already integrated contributions.
If still stacked, integrate the base, retain it until the dependent branch is safely retargeted, forward-integrate actual dev, regenerate bound records and review changed inputs.
Run required current integration checks. Keep zlib provenance review distinct from handwritten archive/state code; do not require an unrelated ULK documentation merge.

tasks.title: Complete restartable USK entries, generations and leases
tasks.prerequisites: Exact streaming contract/source and task authority; named disposable effect tests for qualification. Canaries may begin before canonical integration.
acceptance: Persist and revalidate operation/plan/source/target/entry identities; reuse verified entries, restart incomplete entries and refuse changed or foreign state.
Verify before generation activation; qualify update/rollback, retention, leases, cancellation and truthful terminal/unknown outcomes.
Inject write/receipt/activation faults, disk full and source substitution; exercise admitted formats, beyond-4-GiB offsets and many-entry total memory. State actual restart/power-loss limits.

tasks.title: Qualify a coherent provider package and adopt it exactly
tasks.owner_role: USK + FacMan / provider and product maintainers
tasks.prerequisites: Qualified consumed subset; real provider-main promotion path; separate authorized FacMan adoption. Unchanged ULK is checked as consumed, not promoted for symmetry.
acceptance: Pass relevant source/static/shared/installed/relocated and accepted consumer compatibility tests; generate package/header/ABI identities from actual outputs.
Promote the coherent provider checkpoint under its policy, then import its exact manifest through a separate FacMan lock change; update duplicate projections atomically within that change.
Requalify affected consumer/package evidence. Noncanonical canaries stay identified. Public provider release and ULK truth-only integration are not automatic prerequisites.

tasks.title: Prove packaged existing-install Play and session recovery
tasks.prerequisites: Identified engineering package; accepted process/session mechanism; exact read-only game material and authorized scenario host. Proposed early split of the current Alpha.7 umbrella needs canonical adoption.
acceptance: Register the installation read-only, create an owned isolated instance, inspect readiness, reach the real menu, exit, record Last Run and relaunch.
Exercise stale readiness, failed/lost spawn acknowledgment, frontend/transport death and stable process identity with independent process/filesystem observations and negative controls.
Report scoped engineering route results and remaining target gaps; do not wait for managed installation or call early evidence final release/human acceptance.

tasks.title: Preserve CLI/RPC compatibility and finish shared terminal mechanics
tasks.prerequisites: Current command law, actual invocation and existing terminal fixtures. Full ordinary outcome closure belongs to F19.
acceptance: Capture grammar/aliases/exits/RPC framing/wait defaults; preserve accepted-versus-terminal semantics, no prompts in machine modes and executable help/examples.
Qualify stream redirection, EOF/broken pipes, empty and dash-prefixed operands, native paths, bounded events and control-sequence sanitization.
Preserve colourless fullscreen, both renderers, focus/resize/grapheme/paste handling and declared cleanup; separate deadlines, detach and cancellation. No library migration without a reproduced need.

tasks.title: Finish ordinary instance and configuration workflows
tasks.prerequisites: Existing identity/configuration contracts and owned fixtures. Full multi-domain Make Ready closes in F11.
acceptance: Complete admitted instance lifecycle and round trips with ownership, collision and unavailable-installation handling.
Expose supported presets/layers/overrides, validation and effective-value provenance through machine/human CLI and both ordinary TUI modes.
Keep readiness/backend actions revision-bound. Start native typed controls as semantics stabilize; no frontend-side policy joins.

tasks.title: Complete local content and modpack reconstruction
tasks.prerequisites: Current instance/content identity contract and local material fixtures; no dependency on every instance UI action or managed-install feature.
acceptance: Import, resolve, lock, diff, apply, verify and roll back local content through public application and terminal paths.
Reconstruct an exact lock/settings result in a clean offline workspace; explain missing material/conflicts and preserve user overrides.
Exercise hostile archives/metadata, interrupted apply and retention; preserve rights/custody boundaries and perform no hidden acquisition.

tasks.title: Complete consistent world backup, restore and bundle workflows
tasks.prerequisites: World identity/storage contract and owned save fixtures. Content-linked convergence is completed with F09 in F11.
acceptance: Inspect, back up under a stated consistency policy, restore/fork, associate and round-trip bundles with independent content checks.
Interrupt restore and retention; preserve originals and referenced material. A concurrently changing save must not be represented as a proven consistent backup.
Explain game/content compatibility and irreversible transformation limits. Work can start before the modpack resolver finishes.

tasks.title: Converge managed installation, Make Ready and selected-save Play
tasks.prerequisites: Local-source setup/game lab inputs and effects authorized per scenario. Implement against exact canaries early; canonical closure waits for F05.
acceptance: Complete the managed exemplar: plan/install/verify, damage/repair, interruption/restart, update/rollback and removal with preserved data assertions.
Make Ready orchestrates owned installation/configuration/content/world operations, binds current revisions and explains partial completion without claiming global atomicity.
Qualify selected-save separately from menu; converge managed installation/content/world/session, Last Run, generation leases and recovery through ordinary terminal routes.

tasks.title: Recover native setup effects and complete independent self-maintenance
tasks.prerequisites: Current setup source and named disposable native integration lab. Preserve existing receipts/compensation; provider changes follow their own adoption.
acceptance: Reproduce death/failure between payload receipt, shortcut/registry changes and integration receipt; verify prior ownership and foreign/pre-existing registration preservation.
Implement deterministic discover/resume/compensate/refuse behavior under the owning effect authority; test uninstall and repair after partial completion.
Complete external local-package update/rollback and minimal bootstrap/recovery when GUI/runtime/resources or active generation are damaged; never depend solely on the target being repaired.

tasks.title: Close cross-domain recovery, retention and diagnostics
tasks.prerequisites: Existing recovery/support contracts and owned fixtures. Diagnostics and individual domain recovery begin before all domains close.
acceptance: Expose truthful inspect/resume/rollback/retain/export for workspace, setup, content, worlds and sessions, including corrupt/missing evidence and mixed client versions.
Make cleanup respect live sessions, generations, operations, backups, retention and foreign content; avoid writable aliases into immutable caches.
Keep doctor/safe startup/offline help and bounded adversarially redacted support export useful from damaged packages; exercise ordinary terminal and native recovery routes.

tasks.title: Bind resources and qualify Terminal/Desktop composition
tasks.prerequisites: Exact resource/component identities and producer contract; task-owned package tests. New selected profiles require coherent adoption, not this proposal alone.
acceptance: Bind active resources to executable compatibility and generate a closed runtime/native-dependency inventory; wrong/missing/corrupt resources fail with a usable diagnostic path.
Compose GUI-free Terminal and Desktop overlay from common components; preserve current formats and provide portable/installed-use and maintenance paths for each admitted selection.
Verify relocation, arbitrary CWD, standard-user and damaged-GUI cases; coordinate producers/selectors/manifests and exact profile evidence; derive asset counts from the admitted inventory.

tasks.title: Build production-control galleries and real scenario drivers
tasks.prerequisites: One available target/control and stable typed fixture. Other OS hosts are not prerequisites to begin or close this first reusable scenario.
acceptance: Use actual Launch Deck, plan, progress or recovery controls and reducers with loading/stale/refused/running/unknown states.
Drive genuine API/CLI/PTY/native input paths where available, collect semantic/accessibility/visual/timing traces, and observe effects independently.
Review changed goldens/oracles; retain fixture-versus-real classification. The first scenario is infrastructure proof, not all-target product acceptance.

tasks.title: Complete WinForms ordinary reference workflows
tasks.prerequisites: Stable per-domain typed scenarios permit incremental work; Windows package/input/native lab required for final closure.
acceptance: Finish all applicable local workflows with native ordinary controls and typed application actions, without Advanced or another frontend as a required fallback.
Prove Framework 4.8-specific configuration, mixed-DPI/text/contrast/focus/key/input/accessibility behavior on admitted profiles; keep System Native recovery reliable.
Run real packaged outcomes and reviewed visual/accessibility engineering. Genuine experience acceptance remains F23.

tasks.title: Complete GTK3 ordinary reference workflows

acceptance: Remove confirmed frontend policy reconstruction and finish ordinary local workflows through typed snapshots/actions.
Use native controls/theme/focus/accessibility behavior; qualify the admitted X11 and any separately admitted native Wayland profiles honestly.
Exercise packages, keyboard/pointer and AT-SPI engineering, long/expanded text and recovery; preserve scoped claims and defer genuine experience acceptance to F23.

Record specific preview behavior and limitations, preserving prior receipts and independent Mac terminal completeness.
Do not claim full AppKit graduation, new architecture support or human acceptance from this preview work.

tasks.title: Close the complete terminal matrix from actual packages

acceptance: Close every required J01–J12 human CLI, CLI JSON/RPC, fullscreen and linear outcome with ordinary workflows and exact profile applicability.
Prove terminal operation without GUI/toolkit/display initialization; separately qualify graphical game prerequisites and real routes.
Close compatibility, faults/recovery, assistive engineering, resource bounds, calibrated package performance and executable documentation. No command-count completion claim.

tasks.title: Close integrated engineering qualification and feature freeze
tasks.prerequisites: Required engineering outcome/profile/package cells, retained inputs/results and independent review for relevant high-risk changes.
acceptance: Run mixed-client/retained-state workflows and affected concurrency, migration, fault, privacy, accessibility and performance campaigns.
Resolve known release blockers, unexplained critical-path flakiness and incomplete advertised outcomes; preserve failed attempts and explicit N/A/blocked dispositions.
Freeze required behavior and candidate input closure. This engineering checkpoint does not yet qualify new final signed/versioned delivery bytes or human experience.

tasks.title: Prepare delivery, trust, custody and servicing early

Resolve only necessary publication/checkpoint/maintenance policy gaps; retain current human gates unless separately amended. Identify provider SDK documentation/consumer proof needed for actual claims.
Prepare release/0.1 servicing and forward-port strategy before later-minor promotion. Schedule real provider-consumer subset proof before 0.9; it does not block FacMan 0.1.

tasks.title: Construct and machine-qualify final candidate delivery bytes

Run required tests from final files, bind exact source/provider/resource/profile/host/scenario evidence, and verify durable artifact retrieval.
Assemble a compact acceptance packet. Changing version, source, signature or container triggers new binding and affected qualification; no Alpha-byte relabeling.

Record actual Pass/Fail/Inconclusive observations, candidate/host identities and limitations; turn defects into reproducible engineering cases.
Repairs return to the affected implementation work and F22 with a new candidate binding; repeat affected experience checks under the actual policy.

tasks.title: Release Beta, rehearse RC, accept 0.1 and begin servicing

Construct RC and final normal-release candidates through F22/F23 as applicable; rehearse upgrade/repair/rollback/remove/withdrawal and support before accepted 0.1 publication.
Preserve immutable tags/assets, service the protected 0.1 line with forward ports, and open only the bounded 0.2 charter. Later 0.3/0.4/1.0 are roadmap outcomes, not completion claims.
